final_message: Fixed `cp`’s positional-argument metadata: it lacked `.num_args(1..)`, so generated Zsh completions offered paths only for the first operand. Declaring it variadic restores destination and additional-source completion. Added a passing regression test; the seven failures in the broader `cp` suite also occur without the fix.
